rule: S_N must not be null
rationale: S_N is the primary identifier and one-to-one join key with Acc_Info_dirty. It is mandatory for referential integrity and has 0% missing values in the sample, confirming it is a required field.

rule: S_N must be unique across all records
rationale: S_N serves as a unique table-level identifier with 30 distinct values across 30 records. Duplicate values would indicate data quality issues.

rule: Every S_N in Cust_Bio_dirty must exist in Acc_Info_dirty.S_N
rationale: S_N is defined as a one-to-one key with Acc_Info_dirty.S_N. Referential integrity must be enforced to ensure all customer bio records have corresponding account info records.

rule: Account_No must not be null
rationale: Account_No is a mandatory business identifier with 0% missing values. It links to financial/account records and must be present.

rule: Account_No must be exactly 4 digits
rationale: Account numbers are 4-digit numeric codes (1001-1028). The intended data type is string to preserve the 4-character format, but currently stored as int64. Values must conform to 4-digit pattern.

rule: Account_No must be unique (no duplicates allowed)
rationale: While near-unique, the sample shows 2 duplicate values (1001, 1010) appearing in multiple records. Unless business rules explicitly allow multiple records per account, duplicates indicate data quality issues requiring deduplication.

rule: Name must not be null
rationale: Name is a mandatory personal identifier field with 0% missing values required for customer identification.

rule: Name must be in Title Case (excluding lowercase particles like bin, binte, s/o, d/o)
rationale: Sample shows case deviations: 'lim wei jie' (all lowercase) and 'WANG SHI JIE' (all uppercase). Standard naming convention requires Title Case. Malay/Indian patronymic particles (bin, binte, s/o, d/o) are correctly lowercase and should be excluded from the case check.

check_params.logic: any((w[0].islower() or w.isupper()) for w in str(row['Name']).split() if w.lower() not in ('bin','binte','d/o','s/o') and len(w) > 1)

rule: ID_No must not be null
rationale: National ID number is a mandatory identifier for identity verification with 0% missing values.

rule: ID_No must follow Singapore NRIC/FIN format: one letter (S, T, F, or G), followed by 7 digits, ending with one uppercase letter
rationale: 93.3% of values follow the standard format (e.g., S8403757E). This rule validates the structural format of Singapore National Registration Identity Card (NRIC) and Foreign Identification Number (FIN).

rule: ID_No must not use known non-standard formats identified in data profiling
rationale: Data profiling identified specific records with incompatible formats: 'F212233V' (6 digits instead of 7) and '1916569C' (missing prefix letter). These require clarification and correction.

rule: Race must not be null
rationale: Race is a mandatory demographic field with 0% missing values.

rule: Race must be one of the canonical values: Chinese, Malay, or Indian (case-sensitive)
rationale: Sample shows inconsistent casing (MALAY, malay, indian) but only three semantic categories. Values must conform to the standardized set after casing normalization.

rule: Gender must not be null
rationale: Gender is a mandatory demographic field with 0% missing values.

rule: Gender must be either Male or Female (case-sensitive)
rationale: Sample shows inconsistent casing (male, FEMALE) but only two semantic categories. Values must conform to the standardized set.

rule: Age must not be null
rationale: Age is a mandatory biographical field with 0% missing values.

rule: Age must be parseable as an integer
rationale: One record contains the text value 'Twenty-five' which is not numeric. Age must be stored as a numeric value for calculations and validation.

rule: Age must be between 0 and 120 inclusive
rationale: Domain constraint for human age. Sample contains invalid negative value (-5) which falls outside plausible human lifespan.

rule: Age must not be negative
rationale: Age represents a non-negative quantity. Negative values (-5 observed) are domain-implausible and indicate data entry errors.

rule: Contact_No must not be null
rationale: Contact number is a required communication field with 6.7% missing values (2 NULLs) observed in the sample. Missing values prevent customer contact.

rule: Contact_No must be a valid Singapore phone number with 8 digits (local) or +65 prefix followed by 8 digits
rationale: Singapore phone numbers require 8 digits. Sample shows inconsistent formatting and one 7-digit value ('8964359') which is invalid. Country code 65 is inferred from sample values.

rule: Email must not be null
rationale: Email is a required contact field with 0% missing values for customer communications.

rule: Email must contain exactly one @ symbol with no whitespace
rationale: Basic structural validation for email addresses. Sample shows 13.3% malformed values missing @ or containing spaces.

rule: Email must not contain known malformed patterns identified in data profiling
rationale: Specific malformed values were identified: 'not-an-email' (missing @), 'zx91 @example.com' (embedded space), 'nabilah@@example.com' (double @), 'useremail.com' (missing @). These require manual correction.

rule: Country must not be null
rationale: Country is a mandatory location field with 0% missing values.

rule: Country must be standardized to 'Singapore' (flag non-standard representations)
rationale: Sample shows 8 different representations of Singapore (SINGAPORE, singapore, SG, S'pore, Singapura, 新加坡, Republic of Singapore). All values should be standardized to the canonical form 'Singapore'.

check_params.logic: str(row['Country']).strip().lower() not in ['singapore', 'sg', 'singapura', 's\'pore', 'republic of singapore', '新加坡'] or False

rule: Street_Name must not be null
rationale: Street name is a mandatory address component with 0% missing values.

rule: Street_Name must be in Title Case
rationale: Sample shows one value in all uppercase ('HOLLAND ROAD') which deviates from the dominant Title Case format used for all other street names.

check_params.logic: any((w[0].islower() or w.isupper()) for w in str(row['Street_Name']).split() if len(w) > 1)

rule: Postal_Code must not be null
rationale: Postal code is a mandatory address component with 0% missing values.

rule: Postal_Code must be a 6-digit code
rationale: Singapore postal codes are 6-digit numbers. Sample shows 4-digit (6907) and 5-digit (99999) values indicating leading zeros were lost or data entry errors occurred. Column should be converted to string type to preserve leading zeros.

rule: Gender must be consistent with gender-encoding name particles (Bin/s/o indicate Male; Binte/d/o indicate Female)
rationale: Malay and Indian naming conventions use specific particles to indicate gender: 'Bin' and 's/o' (son of) indicate male; 'Binte' and 'd/o' (daughter of) indicate female. Sample contains these particles (e.g., 'Danish Bin Kamaruddin', 'Shalini d/o Krishnan'). Mismatches indicate data inconsistency.

check_params.logic: (re.search(r'\b(bin|s/o)\b', str(row['Name']), re.IGNORECASE) and str(row['Gender']).strip().lower() != 'male') or (re.search(r'\b(binte|d/o)\b', str(row['Name']), re.IGNORECASE) and str(row['Gender']).strip().lower() != 'female')

rule: Name must match Acc_Info_dirty.Full_Name for the same S_N (case-insensitive)
rationale: S_N is a one-to-one key between tables. The Name field in Cust_Bio_dirty should be consistent with Full_Name in Acc_Info_dirty for the same individual. Sample shows mismatches (e.g., S_N 16: 'Danish Bin Kamaruddin' vs 'Danish').

check_params.semantic_check: Values must match when compared case-insensitively after trimming whitespace

rule: ID_No must exactly match Acc_Info_dirty.ID for the same S_N
rationale: S_N is a one-to-one key. The national ID number should be identical across both tables for the same individual. Sample shows mismatch at S_N 16: 'S8421753J' vs 'S8421753X'.

rule: Account_No must exactly match Acc_Info_dirty.Account_No for the same S_N
rationale: S_N is a one-to-one key. The account number should be consistent across both tables for the same individual record.

rule: ID_No must be unique within Cust_Bio_dirty
rationale: Column is 96.7% distinct with duplicate value(s) ['F1011121T'] observed; treated as a candidate identifier — duplicates flagged for review.

rule: Email must be unique within Cust_Bio_dirty
rationale: Column is 96.7% distinct with duplicate value(s) ['thm@example.com'] observed; treated as a candidate identifier — duplicates flagged for review.
